name: coops_emulator_backbone
description: Coops Emulator Backbone — a thin, verified wrapper around EmulatorJS's real loader.js and EJS_* API, covering NES, SNES, GB/GBC/GBA, N64, Genesis, Sega CD, Sega 32X, Saturn, Game Gear, Master System, PS1, PSP, NDS, Atari 2600/7800, Atari Lynx, PC Engine, Neo Geo Pocket, WonderSwan, ColecoVision, 3DO, C64, and Arcade/FBNeo (incl. Neo Geo carts). See README for which entries are fully verified vs. flagged.
